name: Lambda High Cold Start Rate
description: Alert when Lambda cold start rate exceeds threshold, indicating potential performance issues

eventTemplate.title: High Cold Start Rate: {dims:dt.entity.aws_lambda_function}
eventTemplate.description:
Lambda function {dims:dt.entity.aws_lambda_function} has a cold start rate of {alert_condition_value}%, exceeding the {threshold}% threshold.

Consider:
- Enabling provisioned concurrency
- Reducing package size
- Optimizing initialization code

Function: {dims:dt.entity.aws_lambda_function}
